quests.title: Where Does the Moon Hide?

dialogue.t: ...Hah.
They seem to be having fun.
Greetings.
Greetings to you too, Luonnotar.
Yes. I saw people playing with their friends using cups at The Flagship, so I borrowed the idea.
They would place a gemstone under a cup, then quickly shuffle the cups atop the table.
Upon stopping, they would have the other player guess which cup the gem was under.
The kuuhenki love the feeling of spinning about while wrapped up in cloth, so I used Miss Mage's hat as a reference and made some improvements.
Wait. So you went to The Flagship... did anyone recognize you?
Some did ask, and I said, "I'm dressing up as the Moon Goddess today. I look just like her, don't I?"
Wow, you've really taken that trick from Moon-Prayer Night and ran with it...
Well... Not entirely, but they didn't talk to me afterward either.
Was my acting not natural? I'll keep practicing somewhere else next time.
Why does it feel like someone learned all the wrong lessons...
Luonnotar would like you to guess where she's hiding. Would you like to play a round?
In that case, please stake 100,000 Mora to start with. Those are The Flagship's rules, after all.
Okay, you definitely should've skipped that lesson!
Was that too easy for you?
Should you come around to play again, I will try to shuffle the hats around faster.
Paimon's curious... How exactly did you play with them earlier?
You can't see anything if you don't use kuuvahki, but if you do use it, you'll see too clearly...
Well, I can open my eyes, right?
Oh yeah. Didn't think of that one...
Luonnotar says that she is very happy, and that we should play again next time.

quests.description: Columbina seems to be playing with kuuhenki in the Silvermoon Hall…
